# 1 Enoch Chapter 20 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Ge'ez MS; cf. 4QEn (Aramaic) | **Section:** Book of Watchers

---

**20:1** And these are the names of the holy-angels who watch:

**20:2** Uriel, one of the holy-angels, who [is] over the world and over Tartarus.

**20:3** Raphael, one of the holy-angels, who [is] over the spirits of men.

**20:4** Raguel, one of the holy-angels who takes-vengeance on the world of the luminaries.

**20:5** Michael, one of the holy-angels, who is set over the best-part of mankind and over chaos.

**20:6** Saraqael, one of the holy-angels, who is set over the spirits, who sin in the spirit.

**20:7** Gabriel, one of the holy-angels, who is over Paradise and the serpents and the Cherubim.

**20:8** Remiel, one of the holy-angels, whom God set over those who rise.

---

*EMET notes: Translated from the Ge'ez (Ethiopic) text. Hyphenated compounds preserve Ge'ez construct chains. Bracketed words [thus] are implied by grammar. This chapter is a catalogue of the seven holy archangels and their domains. The number seven and some names vary between manuscripts; verse 8 (Remiel) is absent in some recensions. "Holy-angels" renders Ge'ez mal'akeya qeddust as a compound. Where 4QEn (Aramaic) fragments survive, significant variants are noted.*
